digest.component_or_area: store ticket description schema and migration tooling
propositions: 108 store tickets carry plain bullet-list Success Criteria blocks that are invisible to acceptance-criteria counting and cannot be individually checkable or tagged
Migrate Success Criteria blocks to Acceptance Criteria checkboxes via rebar.edit_ticket, preserving auditability and defaulting to closed tickets only to avoid invalidating open claims
The rewrite must be idempotent and order-agnostic (handle both SC-before-AC and AC-before-SC orderings without duplication or heading corruption)
All 106 migrated tickets must pass post-verification: no lingering Success Criteria headings, all pass the AC floor (_count_ac_items >= 1), and idempotency holds for re-runs
